name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_exists
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
  ∃ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_iff_take
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w ↔ List.take (↑x.fst) (List.Vector.toList w) = List.Vector.toList x.snd

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_iff_take._simp_1_1
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α}, (l₁ <+: l₂) = (l₁ = List.take l₁.length l₂)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_iff_take._simp_1_2
type: ∀ {α : Sort u_1} {a b : α}, (a = b) = (b = a)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_tailBinPrefix
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (E : ℕ) (p : Fin k) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v) w ↔
    List.Vector.get w 0 = p ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailPrefix E w = v

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  0 < k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (g tau T : ℝ),
        0 < g →
          g < 1 →
            0 < tau →
              tau < g →
                0 < T →
                  Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / tau) < 1 / 2 →
                    ∃ (C2 : ℝ),
                      0 < C2 ∧
                        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                          2 ≤ N0 ∧
                            ∀ (n : ℕ),
                              N0 ≤ n →
                                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                      TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                        ∀ (xi eta epsilon : ℝ),
                                          0 ≤ epsilon →
                                            ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                              (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) omega →
                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g xi epsilon p d (↑j + 1)
                                                    omega →
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d j)) →
                                                    ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                                                      0 < ↑x.fst →
                                                        (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                              List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
                                                          (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                                match d with
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward =>
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j) <
                                                                    w
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward =>
                                                                  w <
                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j)) →
                                                            ↑n ^ (-xi) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ≤ ↑n ^ xi →
                                                                RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta n 0 cuts hn (L + 1) ≤ -eta →
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                                      (fun (z : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                                        ∑ w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),
                                                                          if
                                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x
                                                                                w then
                                                                            ↑((RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.wordCount z
                                                                                    w).choose
                                                                                2)
                                                                          else 0)
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d
                                                                        (↑j + 1) omega) ≤
                                                                    C2 *
                                                                        ↑n ^
                                                                          (-eta + 3 * xi +
                                                                            2 *
                                                                                (Real.log (1 / g) /
                                                                                  Real.log (1 / tau)) *
                                                                              (1 + eta - 2 * xi)) +
                                                                      ↑n ^ 2 * epsilon

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions._proof_1_1
type: ∀ (k D Nf : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nf → ∀ (Nb : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nb → ¬2 ≤ Nf + Nb + 2 → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions._proof_1_2
type: ∀ (k D Nf Nb : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nb → ∀ (n : ℕ), Nf + Nb + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)), ¬Nf ≤ n → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions._proof_1_4
type: ∀ (k D Nf : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nf → ∀ (Nb n : ℕ), Nf + Nb + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)), ¬Nb ≤ n → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions._proof_1_5
type:
∀ (k D Nf : ℕ),
  1 ≤ Nf →
    ∀ (Nb : ℕ),
      1 ≤ Nb → ∀ (n : ℕ), Nf + Nb + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (L : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)), ¬2 ≤ n → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions._simp_1_3
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  (List.take (↑x.fst) (List.Vector.toList w) = List.Vector.toList x.snd) = RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.prefixFirst_of_cylinder
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (hx : 0 < ↑x.fst),
  (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
    List.Vector.get x.snd ⟨0, hx⟩ = p

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_cylinder
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  0 < ↑x.fst →
    (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
      ∃ (E : ℕ) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)), RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v = x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_first
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (hx : 0 < ↑x.fst),
  List.Vector.get x.snd ⟨0, hx⟩ = p →
    ∃ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min (↑x.fst - 1) L)), RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix (↑x.fst - 1) p v = x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_first._proof_1_1
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  0 < ↑x.fst → ∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), ¬min (↑x.fst - 1) L + 1 = ↑x.fst → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  0 < k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (g tau T : ℝ),
        0 < g →
          g < 1 →
            0 < tau →
              tau < g →
                0 < T →
                  Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / tau) < 1 / 2 →
                    ∃ (C1 : ℝ),
                      0 < C1 ∧
                        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                          2 ≤ N0 ∧
                            ∀ (n : ℕ),
                              N0 ≤ n →
                                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                      TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                        ∀ (xi epsilon : ℝ),
                                          0 ≤ epsilon →
                                            ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                              (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) omega →
                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g xi epsilon p d (↑j + 1)
                                                    omega →
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d j)) →
                                                    ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                                                      0 < ↑x.fst →
                                                        (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                              List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
                                                          (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                                match d with
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward =>
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j) <
                                                                    w
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward =>
                                                                  w <
                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j)) →
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ≤ ↑n ^ (-xi) →
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                                  (fun (z : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                                    ↑(RiffleUpperV2.prefixCount x z))
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d
                                                                    (↑j + 1) omega) ≤
                                                                C1 *
                                                                    ↑n ^
                                                                      (-xi +
                                                                        Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / tau) *
                                                                          (1 + xi)) +
                                                                  ↑n * epsilon

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count._proof_1_1
type: ∀ (k D Nf : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nf → ∀ (Nb : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nb → ¬2 ≤ Nf + Nb + 2 → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count._proof_1_2
type: ∀ (k D Nf Nb : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nb → ∀ (n : ℕ), Nf + Nb + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)), ¬Nf ≤ n → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count._proof_1_3
type: ∀ (k D Nf : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nf → ∀ (Nb n : ℕ), Nf + Nb + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)), ¬Nb ≤ n → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count.match_1
type:

  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) →
    (Unit → motive RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward) →
      (Unit → motive RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward) → motive d
